Team Vitality is a French professional esports organization which entered Counter-Strike: Global Offensive in early October 2018. They are commonly regarded as one of the most successful organizations in CS history, having won over 20 S-tier trophies, including three Majors, and being the only organization to win two consecutive ESL Grand Slams. Vitality is best known for its French-turned-international lineup, which has notably featured Mathieu "ZywOo" Herbaut and long-time in-game leader Dan "apEX" Madesclaire.

Records

[edit]
  • Records tied to Valve Majors:
    • Second team after Natus Vincere (and last) to win a CS:GO Major without dropping a map, doing so at BLAST.tv Paris Major 2023. [76]
    • Winning StarLadder Budapest Major 2025 made Vitality the fourth team to win back-to-back Majors (after Fnatic, Luminosity Gaming/SK Gaming and Astralis) and the third team to win three Majors in total (after Fnatic and Astralis).
  • Records tied to ESL Grand Slams:
    • Fifth team to win an ESL Grand Slam after Astralis, Team Liquid, Natus Vincere and FaZe Clan. [77]
    • First (and only) team to win two ESL Grand Slams. [78]
    • First (and only) team to win two ESL Grand Slams in a row. [78]
  • Records tied to winning streaks at CS:GO and CS2 Big Events:
    • Has the longest title streak with 7 titles in a row. [79]
    • Has the second-longest final streak with 7 straight finals.
    • Has the longest semi-final streak with 21 consecutive top 4 placements. [80]
    • Has the longest playoffs streak with 34 consecutive top 8 placements.
    • Has the longest LAN series (Bo3+) win streak with 37 series won in a row. [81]
    • Has the longest LAN match win streak with 30 consecutive matches won. [82]
    • Has the second-longest LAN map win streak with 24 consecutive map victories. [83]
    • Has the longest LAN playoffs map win streak with 28 consecutive map victories. [80][84]
  • Records tied to winning streaks (all tournaments):
    • Has the longest LAN series (Bo3+) win streak in with 37 series won in a row, doing so from February 2025 to August 2025, when it was broken by MOUZ.
    • Has the second-longest LAN match win streak with 30 consecutive victories, doing so from February 2025 to June 2025, when it was broken by Legacy. [85]
    • Has the second-longest LAN win streak on Dust II with 16 consecutive map victories. [86]
    • Has the second-longest LAN playoffs map win streak with 28 consecutive map victories. [80][84]
  • Fewest deaths in a first half (17) and map (21) in a CS2 arena [87]
